title: Dated files trace the path to public release: median acquisition age 2.2 years, software-release age at least 3.4
sub: Age at public release of the latest raw-file acquisition date (datasets with dated raw-file names, 34% of those with raw files), the sequence database date and the software release (first seen in PRIDE; lower bound). The plot excludes one negative database interval and two negative software intervals; ages above 10 years are pooled in the final bin.
